meaning:
κεραμικός, -ή, -όν
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:41 (פֶּחָר)* ;]
1. (cl.) of a potter (e.g. γῆ).
2. In LXX and NT, = cl., κεραμεοῦς (Plut., κεράμειος, Polyb., -μαῖος, etc), earthen: Rev.2:27.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots; as I also have received of my Father:
